preview_pipeline_decision.next_step: Add a small headless engine capture mode that loads one actor clip, loops it for a fixed duration, and emits a WebP/PNG strip under a committed preview path.
preview_pipeline_decision.status: decision-recorded; preview artifact generation not implemented in this catalog patch
why: The native engine already resolves ASE clips, textures, frame timing, and actor orientation.
Extending ASE-to-GLB with animation timelines would duplicate runtime animation logic.
A browser ASE previewer would add a second renderer/parsing path for the same question.
